**Starlight Drive-In** is a location in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Burning Springs* update. It is a Public Workshop with claim and defend event quests.

Located on Route 7, Starlight Drive-In was the entertainment destination for the people of what would become known as Burning Springs, Ohio. A theater owned by Starlight Theaters Inc, this Ohio location was managed by movie enthusiast William Knight. [1] The location had a series of films slated for its October and November months, including the newly released film "Echos from Nowhere." [2] In addition to this, Starlight Drive-In hosted a series of employee events for the Abraxodyne Chemical company, with events booked through the month of October. [3] Starlight Theaters management mandated that for the month of October, the employees must wear costumes themed around the films they were showing. [4]

- Three Abraxodyne Intel:
 - One on the landing of the staircase between the first and second floor of the concession stand.
 - One in the back behind the screen on the shelf of a shed.
 - One on the catwalk of the billboard, outside of the drive-in.
- Invoice - STOH-WH101 - Note, on a desk in an office, in the building with the restrooms.
- National Park Ad - 13 Holotapes:
 - One on the left side of the Cash Register, on the right hand side of the counter.
 - Six on a console in an office, in the building with the restrooms.
 - Six on a metal shelf in the same location as above.
- Managers Office Key - Two keys:
 - One on a dead Rust Raider, in the room behind the movie screen.
 - One on a dead Rust Raider in an office, in the building with the restrooms.
- Personal Note - Note, on a desk in an office, in the building with the restrooms.
- Three potential Vault-Tec Bobblehead spawns:
 - Next to a cardboard box and a radio, inside the concession stand, the building with the giant ice cream cone on top.
 - In the rafters of the RV behind the movie screen.
 - In a stall in the men's bathroom.

The Managers Office Key can be used to open the back of the projector screen. Inside there is a Mini Nuke, a Fat Man, four Fusion Cores, and a T-45 helmet.

Starlight Drive-In appears in *Fallout 76*.

1. ↑ *"I still can't believe it, I actually bought Griffin Mays' sidearm from Frontier Justice. The real thing. Not a replica, not a studio prop. The actual piece he used as Marshal Holt Avery.
They had it under glass like it was some ancient treasure (which, let's be honest, it basically is). I wasn't even planning on buying anything. I just went in for a look! But the second I saw that grip, I knew I wasn't leaving without it.
Six thousand dollars. Six grand. Every cent worth it.
Still deciding whether to mount it in my office or keep it tucked away. Either way, this is going in the will."*
(Personal Note)
2. ↑ *"Movie Name: Echoes From Nowehere
Genre: Horror
Premiering November 1st. When systems start to fail aboard Horizon Deep, a remote station orbiting Titan, a lone engineer must uncover the source of a creeping, unseen terror before it consumes them; and the station entirely. "*
(Starlight Drive-In (Burning Springs) Terminal Entries#Echoes From Nowhere)
3. ↑ *"Abraxodyne Chemical has confirmed their exclusive bookings for the month of October. All dates have been locked into the projection schedule. Staff have been instructed accordingly, and concessions will be scaled to match attendance expectations.
Confirmed Bookings:
Employee Morale Night - October 4, 2077
Safety Division Briefing - October 11, 2077
Family Appreciation Evening - October 18, 2077
Management Strategy Review - October 24, 2077
Halloween Costume Gala - October 30, 2077
Notes from Management:
All October bookings are private functions. No public ticket sales.
Abraxodyne representatives will provide their own staff for raffle prizes and event coordination.
Security presence is required at all restricted screenings, particularly the Management Strategy Review - October 24, 2077.
Ensure projection equipment is tested and operational one day prior to each booking. Abraxodyne expects zero technical issues.
Confirmation:
Contracts signed and on file. Payment received in full.
- W. Knight
Manager, Starlight Theaters Inc (Ohio)"*
( Confirmed Bookings)
4. ↑ *"1. Once again, Starlight Management has mandated we suit up to excite the crowds! Themed suits will be provided for each viewing: killer clown outfits for Honk Honk Stab Stab, mummy outfits for The Tomb of Amun-Ra, classic rubber monster suits for Night of the Fish Men's Revenge, and fursuits for The Devil's Moon. Let's make this an unforgettable experience for our guests!
2. Henry, please double-check that projector maintenance is up to date; we don't want another incident like last month's "Silent Film Night!
3. Stock up the concession stand with Nuka-Cola Quantum, BlamCo Popcorn, and fancy new Sugar Bomb candy bags for the holiday crowd.
Let's make this October the spookiest and most thrilling one yet. Your dedication makes all the difference, so let's reel them in (pun intended)!
See you under the stars,
William Knight
Manager"*
( October 2077)
